definition: חֲרַכִּים noun [masculine] plural lattice or other opening through which one may look (Aramaic חֲרַכָּא ᵑ7 Josh 2:15 and elsewhere=Hebrew חַלּ֖וֺן ; but Late Hebrew חֲרָךְ is an opening smaller than a window) — only ׳ מֵצִיץ מִןהַֿח Song 2:9 peeping in at the lattice (|| מַשְׁגִּיחַ מִןהַֿחַלֹּנוֺת ).
